So THAT'S what the zeroes were about 🩷 Taylor spent two weeks turning every O in her bios into a 0 — and today it paid off: 'Patient Zero,' a brand-new single, plus three more songs on The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore. Step into the era:

mediaCredit: Paolo Villanueva (CC BY 2.0), via Wikimedia Commons
altText: Taylor Swift performing the reputation set of the Eras Tour in Inglewood, 2023, in a black snake-motif costume under dark green stage lighting.
why: X sibling of the 09-25 event-weighting beat (see the IG item's why for the full step-4.5 rationale, multi-outlet sourcing, displacement of the Taylor's Version vault beat, and blocklist-safety). Written first as its own post and deliberately leads on a DIFFERENT angle from the IG — the payoff of the two-week zeroes-for-O's easter egg — naming 'Patient Zero' + 'three more songs' rather than re-listing all four titles, so it clears the cross-post-copy gate (<80%; the first draft was 86% and was rewritten). Same story-unique campaign + scheduledAt as the IG. Facts CONFIRMED across major outlets: single 'Patient Zero' + the four-track The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore, out 2026-09-25, teased ~two weeks with zeroes-for-O's. No reception/chart/lyric claims. Deep link /?era=tloas (the site's real Showgirl era). Media: reputation-inglewood-2023, a 7-day-clear credited photo (last use 09-18), DISTINCT from the IG's evermore tile (L001), carrying the required X media with no era-relevance claim (no TLOAS-era photo exists) — hence mediaEarnsItsPlace 3. photoEra unset. Weighted length under 270. Lyric-free. rulesChecked [L001].

critique.rationale: Release-day X: the two weeks of zeroes-for-O's finally pay off — 'Patient Zero' as a single plus three more songs on The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore, out today. Leads on the easter-egg reveal so it reads distinct from its IG sibling, and points to our Showgirl era. Tour photo carries the required X media.
